clips.title: The story
paras: Along the road through western Ashenvale, Maestra's Post watches the way between Astranaar and the Ruins of Ordil'Aran. Night elven Sentinels guard the settlement, where a few humans serve the Alliance.

Maestra's Post keeps watch beneath the trees of western Ashenvale. A slender night elven tower and an open lodge mark the settlement along the road between the coast of Darkshore and Astranaar. Sentinels scan the surrounding wilds as corrupted furbolg stir nearby. Horde movements also threaten Alliance supply lines.

Maestra's Post brings a handful of human allies to live among the night elven Sentinels. Feero Ironhand and Delgren the Purifier lend their martial strength and devotion to the holy Light in service of the Alliance. This remote campsite is an early meeting place between the eastern kingdoms and Kalimdor's ancient defenders.
